meta.title: MYGLOW — magical journal, planner and grimoire
meta.description: Open and close each day with intention, follow the Moon and learn magic at your own pace. A journal, planner and astrological grimoire in one place.

hero.title: Your magical journal, planner and grimoire — all in one place.
hero.lead: Open and close each day with intention, follow the Moon and learn magic at your own pace.

journal.title: Journal
journal.text: Morning, body and night: small rituals that give shape to your day.

planner.text: Week, month and year with the Moon, the signs and the magical dates.

grimoire.text: Short lessons on rituals, elements, planets and crystals.

body.title: Body.
body.text: Water, stretching and movement, kept simple.

night.title: Night.
night.text: Gratitude, mood and a reflection to close the day.

moon.title: Today's Moon.
moon.text: Phase and sign, with the exact time of every change.

chart.title: Your natal chart.
chart.text: Calculated from your birth date, time and place.

readings.title: Personal readings.
readings.text: Your day, week and month in the light of transits to your chart.

rituals.title: Monthly rituals.
rituals.text: Simple, safe suggestions for the dates that matter.

grimoire.title: Learn by doing
grimoire.map: A map of short lessons, from the basics to advanced.
grimoire.daily: Three new lessons a day, with reviews so you don't forget.
grimoire.badges: A badge for every course you complete.

glow.title: Every act of care lights you up
glow.text: Earn Glow by looking after yourself and level up at your own pace.
glow.note: No guilt: you never lose Glow.

install.title: Install it on your phone
install.text: MYGLOW works like an app, with gentle reminders so you never lose the thread of your day.
install.iphone: On iPhone: open it in Safari, tap Share and choose “Add to Home Screen”.

astrology.q: Do I need to know astrology?
astrology.a: No — the Grimoire teaches you everything the app uses, in short lessons.

privacy.a: Yes. Your reflections, gratitude and notes are never sent to AI services; readings only use the sky and your natal chart.

devices.q: Does it work on iPhone and Android?
devices.a: Yes. Open MYGLOW in your browser and add it to your home screen; it also works on desktop.

beta.a: MYGLOW is ready to use, but we're still fine-tuning it. There may be bugs and changes — and your feedback really matters.

consent.title: How {name} works
consent.intro: At the end of each week and month, {name} reads what you wrote and gives you a reading with what to keep, what to adjust and 3 focuses.
consent.sent: Intentions, banishings, gratitudes, reflections, summaries, week notes and goals by area, plus the period's numbers (days, rituals, body, Glow, lessons). Mood, waking and sleep are sent only as averages, and only if you allowed wellbeing data. Emails, phone numbers and links are removed before sending.
consent.never: Your name, email, weight, birth date and place, and your notes on how you woke up.
consent.who: Google, through the paid Gemini API, which does not use this data to train models. It may keep it for a limited time to detect abuse.
consent.off: In Settings you can turn {name} off and delete all readings.
consent.notProfessional: {name} is not a substitute for professional help.
